bagPolicy.summary: Backpacks and any bag larger than a handbag or briefcase are not allowed at Place Bell. All guests are searched at entry.
prohibited: Bags larger than a handbag or briefcase
bagPolicy.note: Policy as posted on the Montreal Victoire (PWHL) game-day FAQ, which cites the security directives in place at Place Bell. Place Bell's own FAQ did not load. Prohibited bags cannot be left at the coat check. Searches can slow entry, so arrive early.
